University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences
Panjab University, Sector 14, Chandigarh 160014
Ref No. 1011/UIPS Date: 22.02.2023
NOTICE
Applications are invited from the suitable candidates for the positions of Guest
Faculty in University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences (UIPS) in the following
subjects for the current academic session 2022-2023 (Even Semester) for B. Pharm
and M. Pharm:

Desirable Qualification: Preference would be given to experienced candidate
with Ph.D/NET/GPAT/GATE qualified.
The application must reach to the office of the UIPS in the attached format, latest by
the extended deadline i.e. 25.02.2023 through post/by hand alongwith the
Curriculum Vitae, photocopy of all documents supporting the credentials specifying
the Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Marital Status, Address, Contact/Mobile Number,
E-mail Id as per the Qualification and Experience mentioned above.
The eligible candidates will be required to appear for Walk in interview on
27.02.2023 at 02:30 p.m. in the office of the Chairperson, UIPS.
The candidate is required to bring all the supporting documents in original at the time
of the interview for verification. No TA/DA would be admissible.
Payment:
Rs. 1000/- for Ph. D/NET/GATE qualified candidates (Rs. 500/- for others) per
Theory lecture/Practical of 2/3 hours with a ceiling on maximum monthly payment of
not more than Rs 25,000/- per month or subject to revision.
